title: Digital Queen of Code
description: A woman in a glowing green bodysuit stands atop a mound of dark earth, holding a large white computer monitor that emits smoke and code. She balances a golden crown with purple jewels on her head while a colorful, polka-dotted ballerina made of particles dances above her, emerging from swirling yellow patterns and colorful orbs against a dark background.
prompt: Surreal digital artwork of a woman in a vibrant green bodysuit standing on a pile of dark earth, holding a white computer monitor displaying code with smoke swirling around it. She balances an ornate golden crown with purple jewels on her head. Above her, a ballerina figure made of colorful polka dots and glowing particles dances gracefully, surrounded by swirling yellow ornamental patterns and floating multicolored orbs on a dark background.
